name: The First Night-Glow Cup (Dạ Quang Bôi)
lore: A thin jade cup that glows in the dark, taken from a merchant's chest on Hạng Dạ Bôi's first raid in 970. The raiders' custom of drinking from night-glow cups after every raid and leaving one behind (A121) began with it. He has never left this one.
build_use: The blood sabre's sustain: leech and health while arts are paid in blood.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Night Sabre (Dạ Đao)
lore: A black curved sabre quenched in its maker's blood nine times (the Nine-Temper way). Hạng Dạ Bôi forged it in 1000. It is the sabre that cut the horses out from under the Pavilion's riders at Huyết Đao Trại in 1121, before he knelt.
build_use: A blood duelist's sabre: crit damage, bleed stacks, part of each art paid in health.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Red Feather (Xích Linh Đao)
lore: A light red sabre with a hawk's feather knotted to the pommel, which Đồ Xích Linh took from a Băng Tâm rider she killed in 1120. She wears the feather to remind the Pavilion's envoys every time they visit.
build_use: Fast Fire cuts and burning stacks.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Tally of the Lost Silver (Thất Ngân Bài)
lore: The Desert Pavilion's silver tally for the tax caravan lost in 968, taken from his hanged brother's belt. He has worn it on a cord since and has never paid it back.
build_use: Blood sustain and the blood-paid arts: Blood Casting (as the catalogue's Ring of Blood Kindling, which Hạng now keeps unworn) lets his arts run on health once linh lực is gone; the leech pays it back.

name: Felt Rider's Coat (Chiên Kỵ Giáp)
lore: Red-dyed felt from the tents of Chiên Trướng Thôn, layered over a Băng Tâm rider's mail she cut off its owner in 1120.
build_use: A raider's coat: health to pay for blood-bought cuts.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Gambler's Ember Ring (Đổ Hỏa Giới)
lore: Won at dice from a Trường Vân caravan master who did not know what he was betting; there is a live ember in the bezel.
build_use: Fast Fire cuts and heavier Burn.
